example.purpose: Independent reactive Counter components with scoped CSS
example.scope: Experimental Python browser compiler M1–M4; same Counter source as web new scaffold. Compiler evidence is separate from mandatory Chromium/Vite HMR tests.
example.source:
use nexo.web

pub component Counter:
    state count: int = 0

    fn increment():
        count += 1

    view:
        main:
            h1("Nexo Web")
            p("Count: {count}")
            button("+", on_click: increment)

    style:
        main {
            padding: 24px;
        }
